rows.question: Why can the same 30-day fill cost more at a standard pharmacy than a preferred one on this plan?
rows.answer: On this plan, preferred retail and standard retail are different cost-share categories for the same days supply when the pharmacy’s network classification differs on the date of service. For the matched 30-day metformin 500 mg supply under the recorded conditions, preferred retail is $8 and standard retail is $27. The difference is the cost-share category applied at the pharmacy on that date, not a change to the written prescription.
